CustomField.formula:
TRIM( BLANKVALUE(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.FirstName, "") &
IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.FirstName)), NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.MiddleName)) ), " ", "" ) &
BLANKVALUE(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.MiddleName, "") &
IF( AND( OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.FirstName)), NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.MiddleName)) ), NOT(ISBLANK(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.LastName)) ), " ", "" ) &
BLANKVALUE(Opportunity__r.BrokerAgentContact__r.LastName, "") )
